users.label: Users
users.description: Search user accounts and manage their roles, SAML identities, and sessions.

roles.label: Roles
roles.description: Manage roles and the permissions granted to them.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.description: Manage the permission codes available for role grants.

templates.label: Email templates
templates.description: Edit and preview notification templates for email and in-app messages.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.description: See who notifications go to, when, and which failed.

emailGroups.label: Email groups
emailGroups.description: Manage notification email groups and their member addresses.

saml.label: SAML
saml.description: Configure SAML identity and service providers for single sign-on.

orgUnits.label: Org units
orgUnits.description: Manage the organizational tree and each unit's addresses, closures, and hours.

orgUnitTypes.label: Org unit types
orgUnitTypes.description: Manage the categories of org units (system, region, branch, …) and what each may contain.

errors.notFoundBody: That page or item does not exist. It may have been deleted.
errors.genericBody: The page could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

status.badRequest: The request was invalid. Check your input and try again.
status.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
status.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
status.notFound: That item no longer exists. It may have been changed by someone else.
status.conflict: That change conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
status.server: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
status.other: The request could not be completed.

codes.NOT_LOCAL_ACCOUNT: This account is managed by the identity provider and can't be edited here.
codes.SAML_MANAGED: This item is managed by SAML and can't be changed here.
codes.PERMISSION_IN_USE: This permission is granted to one or more roles; revoke the grants first.
codes.ROLE_ASSIGNED: This role is assigned to users; remove the assignments first.
codes.ROLE_SAML_MAPPED: This role is referenced by SAML attribute mappings; remove those first.
codes.ATTRIBUTE_IN_USE: Role mappings reference this attribute; remove them first.
codes.ATTRIBUTE_HAS_VALUES: Captured user attribute values reference this attribute.
codes.IDP_IN_USE: This identity provider is referenced by service providers or sessions.
codes.IDP_HAS_IDENTITIES: Users have SAML identities from this IdP; it can't be deleted.
codes.SP_IN_USE: This service provider is referenced by pending authentication requests.
codes.TYPE_IN_USE: Active org units use this type; change them first.
codes.TYPE_HAS_CHILDREN: Other unit types list this type as their parent.
codes.UNIT_HAS_CHILDREN: This unit has active child units; move or delete them first.
codes.UNIT_IS_ROOT: The root org unit cannot be deleted.
codes.PERMISSION_CODE_TAKEN: A permission with this code already exists.
codes.ROLE_CODE_TAKEN: A role with this code already exists.
codes.PERMISSION_ALREADY_GRANTED: This role already has that permission.
codes.ALREADY_ASSIGNED: The user already has this role at this org unit.
codes.ENTITY_ID_TAKEN: A config with this entity ID already exists.
codes.ATTRIBUTE_EXISTS: This IdP already tracks this attribute key with the same normalizer.
codes.MAPPING_EXISTS: This attribute value is already mapped to this role.
codes.TEMPLATE_CODE_TAKEN: A template with this code already exists.
codes.EMAIL_GROUP_CODE_TAKEN: An email group with this code already exists.
codes.EMAIL_ALREADY_IN_GROUP: This email address is already a member of the group.
codes.UNIT_CODE_TAKEN: An org unit with this code already exists.
codes.UNIT_LABEL_TAKEN: An org unit with this label already exists.
codes.TYPE_LABEL_TAKEN: A unit type with this label already exists.
